$comment: Explicit top-level entries scripts/stage-vsix.mjs copies into the throwaway stage directory before vsce packages it. This list IS the vsix contents when there is no .vscodeignore in the stage: every entry is copied whole (no pruning), so the packaged extension matches what a root-based vsce run would ship, minus vsce's own defaultIgnore (CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, .github, package-lock.json, ...). It is consulted by src/ui/settings/app/packaging.test.ts, which pins the runtime dependency closure against the node_modules entries below. Keep both sides in sync if a new root asset ships.
